texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]遇到了奇怪的情况：我们显然定居到了某种巨大的两栖爬行动物身上，他们的骨质外壳由多种奇特的矿物构成。许多我们认为是当地岛屿的其实都是这种生物，我们的殖民者则将他们称为“尼玛”。

他们看起来人畜无害，由于我们并没有深入他们的外壳，他们应该几乎没注意到我们。
texts.en:
Our colony on [Root.GetName] has encountered an odd situation: we have apparently settled on the back of a gargantuan amphibian reptile, whose bony shell is formed of various exotic minerals. Most of what we thought were local islands have turned out to be these creatures; our colonists have begun to refer to them as 'Nemmas'.

They seem harmless enough, and as long as we don't dig too deep into their shell, they should barely notice us.

texts.zh: 巨大的尼玛居住在我们的一个星球上，我们已经在他们的背上建立了一个殖民地的基础。我们将决定它们的命运。
texts.en: The titanic Nemma inhabit one of our worlds and we have already built the foundation of a colony on their backs. We will need to decide what to do with them.

texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地正在繁荣发展，这个新殖民地的青少年当然要为自己创造一些娱乐，就像所有年轻人都会做的一样。一个团体发明了一种互相比拼悄悄接近当地尼玛头部的游戏。

不幸的是，这一大胆的行动导致了悲剧：在惊吓到了这只巨兽之后，一些年轻的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从这只巨大生物的颈部坠落，造成多名人口受伤，其中一位不治身亡。

烦躁的殖民者现在要求实施一些举措来应对这些“残暴的巨兽”。
texts.en:
As our colony at [Root.GetName] has been flourishing, the adolescents of this new world have sought to create entertainment for themselves - as youths are wont to do. Some groups have made a game of sneaking up as close as they dare to their local Nemma's head.

Unfortunately, this daring activity has led to tragedy: after startling the beast, several young [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fell off the neck of the massive creature, resulting in injuries and one fatality.

Distraught colonists are now asking for something to be done about these "brutish behemoths."

texts.zh:
在我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地繁荣发展时，显然尼玛对我们前往其头部的无人机感到非常地不适。特别是在这只野兽畏缩并从它的脖子上甩下了许多[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，造成明显损失时尤为明显。

如果不进行一些举措处理这些巨兽我们的进展将会受到影响。
texts.en:
While our [Root.GetName] colony has been flourishing, it has become apparent that Nemmas have a strong aversion to our drones venturing near their head. This became starkly apparent when one such beast flinched and dislodged several [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from its neck, causing severe damage.

Our progress will be restrained unless we do something to handle these behemoths.

label.zh: 让这些年轻人玩儿去吧。
让这些年轻人玩儿去吧。
我们之后尽量避免再刺激到这些生物。
label.en: We will avoid agitating the creatures further.

texts.zh: 应该让尼玛处于在我们最好的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]的保护之下，然后试图寻找解决方案。
texts.en: We shall put the fate of the Nemma in the care of our best [Owner.GetScientistPlural] and see what solutions can be found.

texts.zh:
派遣我们最好的生物学家和工程师为[Root.GetName]上的尼玛困境寻找潜在的解决方案，许多提案现已经完成可以呈交。

我们考虑了从最普通到最极端的所有想法。这一情况的紧迫程度要求我们直接跳到现场调研查中。
texts.en:
Having tasked our best biologists and engineers with devising potential solutions for the Nemma dilemma on [Root.GetName], several proposals are now ready to be presented.

We've considered everything from the most rational to the most extreme of ideas. The urgency of this situation demands we must skip straight to live field tests.

label.zh: 繁育更多尼玛，并保护他们的安全以获得更多生存空间。
label.en: Breed more Nemmas and safeguard them for more living space.

label.zh: 奴役这些尼玛，让他们为我们所用。
label.en: Enslave the Nemmas so that they become deferential and compliant.

label.zh: 够了！摁住这些尼玛，钻取他们的外壳。
label.en: Enough! Sedate the Nemmas, and start drilling their shells.

texts.zh: 通过对尼玛的初步研究，并结合我们的动物学知识，现在可以鼓励这一温顺驯服的物种在它们栖息地的承载范围内欣欣向荣地发展。
texts.en: By first studying the Nemmas and then applying our zoological expertise, we can encourage docile and obedient specimens to flourish within the carrying capacity of their habitat.

texts.zh: 在一些对成年个体的初步试验之后，我们的动物学家已经在[Root.GetName]上设立了一个尼玛繁育系统，以期为海洋带来更多的巨大尼玛。繁育者提示，这不可能无限地进行下去，因为这颗行星只能再承载额外三只或者四只尼玛。我们得到下一只尼玛的时间大约需要十年。
texts.en: After initial trials with the adult specimen, our zoologists have set up a Nemma breeding system on [Root.GetName] in the hopes of introducing more giant Nemmas to our oceans. The breeders warn that this cannot continue indefinitely, and that the planet can only support three, perhaps four more Nemmas. The estimated time until we have our next Nemma should be about ten years.

texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的繁育计划结出了硕果，另一只尼玛加入了我们的行列！这个幼年个体很快适应了我们的存在，而我们发现它是一座稳定的栖息地。这只尼玛现在已经准备好承载我们的产业了。

然而，由于已经达到了生态承载上限，这将会是这个星球上最后一只新增的尼玛。我们的牧尼玛人必须在繁育尼玛之外寻找新的着力点，就是说他们需要更好地维护已有的尼玛。
texts.en:
Our breeding program on [Root.GetName] bears fruit as we add another Nemma to our ranks! This juvenile has quickly acclimated to our presence, and we have found it a stable habitat. The Nemma should now be ready to bear our industry.

This will, however, have to be the last Nemma added to this world, as their habitat has reached capacity. Our Nemma wranglers will have to refocus their efforts not on breeding more Nemmas, but instead on maintaining what they already have created.

texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的繁育计划结出了硕果，另一只尼玛加入了我们的行列！这个幼年个体很快适应了我们的存在，而我们发现它是一座稳定的栖息地。这只尼玛现在已经准备好承载我们的产业了。
texts.en: Our breeding program on [Root.GetName] bears fruit as we add another Nemma to our ranks! This juvenile has quickly acclimated to our presence, and we have found it a stable habitat. The Nemma should now be ready to bear our industry.

label.zh: 叹为观止！能再表演一遍那个吗！
对这个项目而言真是令人满意的结果。
label.en: This is a satisfactory conclusion to the project.

texts.zh: 难过的是我们最近尝试在[Root.GetName]增添另一只尼玛的努力失败了；我们无法为这么巨大的生物寻找到足够的栖息空间。但[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]并没有沮丧，并且承诺未来会取得更好的结果。
texts.en: Sadly the latest effort to add another Nemma to [Root.GetName] has failed; we could find no habitat spacious enough for such a massive beast to thrive. The [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are not dismayed, however, and promise better results in the future.

texts.zh: 先进的药物和义体植入体可以将尼玛变得更加温顺和易于操控。这一以来它们就可以成为负载能力强大的巨兽。
texts.en: Advanced drugs and cybernetic implants will render the Nemmas more docile and impressionable. In time they shall become gigantic beasts of burden.

texts.zh:
我们的外星生物工程师[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]成功驯服了尼玛威胁！由于我们不懈的努力，这些生命现在向我们臣服了。

这些尼玛获得了新的用途：最高级的驮畜。他们庞大的躯体使得他们可以搭载难以计量的材料，由神经植入体引导选择最优的路线。我们的殖民活动也由此得到了加速。
texts.en:
Our xeno-bioengineering [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have curtailed the Nemma menace! Thanks to our superb efforts, the creatures are now subservient to us.

The Nemmas have been granted renewed purpose as superlative beasts of burden. Their colossal bulk allows them to carry immense quantities of materiel, guided down optimal routes by way of their cybernetic implants. Our colonization effort has accelerated accordingly.

label.zh: 棒极了，现在我们可以开始干点正事了。
label.en: Excellent work, now our true work can begin.

texts.zh:
今天在[Root.GetName]上爆发了一些骚乱，部分人口奋起抗议我们对尼玛的对待方式。这些抗议者在围着尼玛的头部也就是殖民首府的所在地排成了人墙。抗议者要求我们立刻将尼玛放归自由，并致力维系这些物种而不是奴役他们。

这一运动很快扩散到了其他尼玛身上的其他地方——然而，利于我们目前计划的反抗议也在形成，公共矛盾逐渐升级，并有爆发出暴力冲突的危险。
texts.en:
Today riots broke out on [Root.GetName] as parts of the population have risen in protest against our treatment of the Nemmas. The protestors formed a picket line around the head of the Nemma on which the colony's capital lies. The protestors demanded that we immediately set all the Nemmas free, working to conserve their species rather than enslave them.

The movement has quickly spread to sites around the other Nemmas - however, counter-protests have formed in favor of our existing programs, escalating public tension and risking outbursts of violence.

label.zh: 逮捕煽动者然后让他们去扫大街。
label.en: Arrest the instigators and put them on waste disposal duty.

texts.zh: 在小心地研究了尼玛的生物学构成后，我们的[Root.owner.GetScientistPlural]可以有效地才这些巨星爬行动物的外壳中收获有用的矿物。
texts.en: After carefully studying the Nemmas' biology, our [Root.owner.GetScientistPlural] can successfully harvest useful minerals from the shells of these gigantic reptiles.

texts.zh: 我们的工程师和生化学家实现了自我超越。新开发的药物和极度精确的钻头让我们可以在不威胁到我们基础设施的前提下通过钻入这些尼玛的坚硬晶质外壳中获取矿物，同时还能获取生物质。我们所有的殖民地中只有这里可以产出这样的资源。
texts.en: Our engineers and biochemists have outdone themselves. Newly developed drugs and extremely precise drills will allow us to harvest the minerals by drilling into the hard crystalline shell of these Nemmas, as well as allowing us to collect biomatter from beneath without jeopardizing our infrastructure. If only all our colonies could yield such bounties.

texts.zh: 我们将不择手段从这个星球上将尼玛的威胁清除干净。
texts.en: We will expunge the Nemma menace from this planet by any means necessary.

title.zh: 消灭这些长寿的爬行动物

texts.zh: 对尼玛的净化已经完成了——极度地系统化，因此既没有污染海洋也没有威胁到我们的基础设施。很快我们可以将我们的注意力转移到收获它们的尸骸中，并在[Root.GetName]上建立更多的永久殖民地。首先，我们得先储存好这些残羹剩饭。
texts.en: The purging of the Nemmas has been completed - all very systematically, so as not to pollute the oceans or otherwise endanger our infrastructure. Soon we can turn our attention to the task of harvesting their remains, and establishing a more permanent and enduring colony on [Root.GetName]. First, however, we need to store all the leftovers.

label.zh: 这是对待这些无脑野兽的最佳方法。
label.en: The only way to handle such mindless beasts.
